    screen.blit(lives_text, (SCREEN_WIDTH - 150, 10))

        screen.blit(game_over_text, (SCREEN_WIDTH // 2 - 100, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2 - 25))

    # Update display
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(FPS)
